map.比重 SG = 1 + (白利度 ÷ 258.6 − (白利度 ÷ 258.2): Specific gravity SG = 1 + (Brix ÷ 258.6 − (Brix ÷ 258.2)²); Brix <= 0 is taken as 1 and >100 is treated as 100. Baumé = Brix ÷ 1.8, and reverse Brix = Baumé × 1.8; refractive index ≈ 1.3330 + Brix × 0.00146. Back-solving Brix from SG is iterative: initial value (SG − 1) × 260, corrected by difference × 200 each round and clamped to 0-100, stopping at |difference| < 0.00001 or after 20 rounds. Concentration tiers: <10 very low, <25 low sugar, <50 medium sugar, <70 high sugar, >=70 very high sugar; the sugar percentage equals the Brix value (grams of sugar per 100 g of solution)
